To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the CMT welding process is suitable for joining galvanized steel to aluminum.
the AlSi5 filler can wet the galvanized steel substrate and form a uniform interface layer.
CMT brazing is a promising joining method for galvanized steel and aluminum alloy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the microstructure of the CMT brazed joint.
the microstructure of AlSi _{5} /galvanized steel CMT brazed joints and the effect of welding parameters on microstructure.
the microstructural evolution of AlSi5 filler on galvanized steel substrate.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CMT welding parameters can be controlled to form the desired Fe-Al layer at the interface between AlSi5 and galvanized steel.
the CMT brazed joint of AlSi5/galvanized steel is feasible.
the microstructure of AlSi/Galvanized steel CMT brazed joints is mainly determined by the welding parameters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the formation of the Fe-Al layer can be accelerated by increasing the wire feed rate and decreasing the welding speed.
CMT welding can be applied to AlSi5/GZ galvanized steel brazing.
the formation of intermetallic compounds in the brazing of galvanized steel and AlSi5 is related to the wetting tip and Fe-Al interface layer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the microstructure and mechanical properties of AlSi5/steel CMT joints can be improved by adjusting the welding process.
the formation of FeAl intermetallic compound and zinc rich region is closely related to the welding speed and the wire feed rate.
the formation of Fe-Zn and Fe-Al intermetallice compounds is related to the wetting tip and the interface layer of the brazed joint.
